Workflow.Name: PPLF | Maintenance | Retention Cleanup
Workflow.Description: Runs daily. Deletes log entries older than the retention period. The * row (or PPLF Default Retention Days) is the maximum age for all entries; a source row can set a shorter period for that source. Deletes up to 5,000 entries per store per rule per run.
